evidenceContract.userBehavior: The Agent discovers EPUB structure with one whole-document ContentLocator and manifest mode without reader-private fields.

observables.description: Exact successful manifest Tool arguments, terminal idle state, and absence of runtime errors or reader-private top-level fields.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The EPUB manifest read succeeds without a top-level strategy and the Agent reports DOCUMENT_MANIFEST_OK.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Argument rejection, top-level strategy/range/next fields, alternate raw paths, runtime errors, or non-idle completion fails visibly.

steps.prompt: 调用一次 openneko_document 读取 workspace 文件 synthetic-document.epub 的 manifest：operation 为 read，source 只包含 workspace file，mode 为 manifest，maxChars 为 12000。不要添加 strategy、selector、range、next、bash、glob 或其他文档调用。成功后回复 DOCUMENT_MANIFEST_OK。
